summary: Start from a stored sealing cursor instead of probing every batch

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Which batches are sealed is unchanged: sealing still seals only batches that lack an envelope.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers. One new meta key, seeded_batch_rowid, written in the transaction that seals a batch; an older build ignores it and a newer build that does not find it computes it the old way once and stores it.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

downtime.detail: Shorter, not longer: the first start that carries it still pays the old 3 to 9 s probe once to store the cursor; every later start skips it (3.4 to 8.7 s of 'startup open-store' on Silber and 0.75 to 5.1 s on hetz in the profiler's records on 2026-10-06).

recovery.detail: Delete the meta key to make the next start recompute the cursor; a cursor behind the truth only lengthens the first seal range.
